description: This file is a shell script containing a series of unit tests for a JSON writer utility. It defines various test cases to verify the correctness of JSON generation from structured input descriptions, including nested objects, arrays, and special characters.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success behavior for given input.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Executes the JSON writer tool with specified arguments.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output against expected output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all tests in the script.
